mapper.select: select m.id, m.user_id as userId, u.account_name as accountName, u.status as userStatus, u.preferred_locale as preferredLocale, m.plan_id as planId, m.tier, m.status, m.started_at as startedAt, m.expires_at as expiresAt, m.created_at as createdAt, m.updated_at as updatedAt, p.billing_type as billingType, p.billing_period as billingPeriod, p.validity_months as validityMonths, p.private_introduction_quota as privateIntroductionQuota, p.event_quota as eventQuota, p.staff_support_level as staffSupportLevel, p.concierge_priority as conciergePriority from cm_user_memberships m join cm_users u on u.id = m.user_id left join cm_membership_plans p on p.id = m.plan_id where m.id = #{id} limit 1
select id, tier from cm_membership_plans where tier = #{tier} and is_active = 1 limit 1
mapper.update: update cm_user_memberships set status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update cm_user_memberships set plan_id = #{planId}, tier = #{tier}, started_at = #{startedAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
